name: mastdiff-search
description: Structural, tree-sitter-powered C++ search inside VS Code — find function definitions, call sites, classes, fields and more with simple fn:/call:/class: queries or raw tree-sitter S-expressions.

commands.title: mastdiff: Find Calls to Symbol Under Cursor
mastdiff: Find Function Definitions of Symbol Under Cursor

mastdiff.binaryPath.description: Path to the mastdiff binary. Defaults to 'mastdiff' on PATH.

mastdiff.include.description: Comma-separated include globs applied to every search (e.g. "src/**,*.hpp"). Empty = search everything.

mastdiff.exclude.description: Comma-separated exclude globs applied to every search (e.g. "tests/**,vendor/**").

mastdiff.debounceMs.description: Debounce in milliseconds before a search fires while typing.

mastdiff.maxResults.description: Maximum number of results shown in the picker.

mastdiff.previewResults.description: Preview the highlighted result in the editor while navigating the picker.
